problem: PointGoal navigation agents reach near-perfect success only with perfect GPS+Compass and noiseless actuation. Prior GPS-free work (supervised VO, SLAM-net) still uses GT position as supervision for training the VO/SLAM modules.
motivation: Accurate GPS is unavailable indoors, so a navigation model should use no position signal at all, neither in training nor in inference. Inspired by animal path integration and landmark calibration, the paper combines a vision-based ego-motion estimate with an action-only integration estimate.
key_idea: Train VO without any GT pose, using re-projection error on RGB+depth+vertical edges and a classification-style pose head (CP-Net), then use the accumulated VO pseudo-positions to supervise an LSTM action-integration module (AIM, with place/head-direction cell encodings) whose features feed the DD-PPO policy.
insight: Richer re-projection cues help: adding vertical edges lifts SR from 55.0 to 62.1 (Rows 3 vs 4). Discretising pose into probability volumes mainly cuts rotation error (3.75 vs 6.68 MAE) and lifts SR from 68.0 to 71.9 with AIM. AIM helps most when VO is weak (+14.7 SR for RGB-only vs +9.4 for the best VO). AIM supervised by pseudo-position loss L_vc beats the policy-gradient-only variant (71.9 vs 67.4 SR), and even a detached AIM trained only with L_vc (67.7) beats a plain embedding layer.
method: Unsupervised VO pipeline: the depth-based warp between adjacent frames gives a photometric re-projection loss, using min over t-1/t+1 frames; depth supplies metric scale and no GT pose is used.
Richer visual cues: the re-projection target is 7-channel RGB + depth + vertical edge (bio-inspired contour detector); MAE+SSIM (0.15/0.85) for RGB and MAE only for depth and edge.

CP-Net: ResNet18 (8-channel input from two RGBD frames) + conv + FC softmax heads output probability volumes over discretised Tx (81 bins), Ty (51) and Rz (51); the pose is the expectation. 14.2M params.
Position feature: 2D VO poses are accumulated (path integration) from the initial GPS goal offset and converted to polar form, giving F_p (32-d FC).

Action Integration Module (AIM): LSTM takes previous action and collision embeddings and outputs the action feature F_a plus place-cell (Gaussian softmax, σ=0.5) and head-direction-cell (Von Mises, N=12) predictions. It is supervised by cross-entropy against the encoded VO pseudo-pose (L_vc, weights 0.05), and also receives policy gradient.
Policy: 2-layer LSTM over ResNet18 depth feature F_v, F_p and F_a, trained with DD-PPO. Stage I trains VO, then stage II freezes VO and fine-tunes the policy from the supVO pretrained checkpoint.

setting.backbone: ResNet18 (GroupNorm) + 2-layer LSTM DD-PPO policy; CP-Net (ResNet18-based) unsupervised VO; LSTM AIM (all trained)
setting.training_data: VO dataset of 100,000 steps from 13,036 shortest-path trajectories in the 72 Gibson-4+ training scenes; policy fine-tuned with DD-PPO in Gibson (initialized from supVO pretrained policy)
setting.observation: egocentric RGB-D (192x341 for policy, 256x256 for VO), previous action and collision signal; no GPS/compass after the first step
setting.action_space: discrete: forward 0.25 m, turn left/right 10°, stop (LoCoBot actuation noise, sliding disabled)
setting.privileged: GPS used only at first step to initialize position (goal offset and AIM initial state); none afterwards

numbers.eval_set_note: Gibson-4+ validation split, 994 episodes from 14 unseen scenes
numbers.backbone: ResNet18 + LSTM policy, CP-Net VO, LSTM AIM
numbers.extra: noisy actuation (LoCoBot), RGB-D noise-free; no GPS/compass beyond initial step; 0.36 m success radius

numbers.backbone: ResNet18 + LSTM policy, CP-Net VO, action embedding

results: On the Gibson-4+ val split, the unsupervised system reaches 71.9 SR / 51.2 SPL / 63.2 SoftSPL, beating supervised DeepVO (50/39), OA (38.4/34.3), SLAM-net (66/38) and supVO-base (61/46). It is below supVO-full (82/63) and the GT-GPS upper bound (95.0/65.9). Performance is sensitive to RGB noise: SR drops to 41.7 at σ=0.05, partly recovered by Gaussian or bilateral filtering (67.6 / 66.8).
limitations: Assumes static scenes and is sensitive to RGB noise because of the re-projection loss (SR 41.7 at σ=0.05)
Only tested in simulation, so sim-to-real transfer is unverified; CP-Net only suits small discrete action spaces
Still below supervised supVO-full, and accumulated VO drift causes wrong endpoints in long-distance episodes
builds_on: Banino et al. grid cells (vector-based navigation)
